name: xlsx_edit
description: Set cell values in an existing Excel .xlsx workbook, keeping the other cells, styles and sheets. Strings starting with '=' become formulas; null clears a cell.

cells.description: {cell reference: value}, e.g. {"B2": 5, "C2": "=B2*2", "A9": "note"}; a value is a string, number, boolean or null

output.description: write the result here instead of changing the file; must not exist

edge_cases: new row or column beyond the used range
cell with a style keeps it
